mapper.sql: prrd.id, prrd.po_reconciliation_id as poReconciliationId, prrd.po_reconciliation_detail_id as poReconciliationDetailId, prrd.supplier_id as supplierId, prrd.supplier_name as supplierName, prrd.source_code as sourceCode, prrd.source_type as sourceType, prrd.return_source_type as returnSourceType, prrd.po_id as poId, prrd.po_code as poCode, prrd.date as date, prrd.sku_id as skuId, prrd.sku_no as skuNo, prrd.qty, prrd.tax_rate as taxRate, prrd.tax_price as taxPrice, prrd.tax_amount as taxAmount, prrd.settle_org_id as settleOrgId, prrd.settle_org_Name as settleOrgName, prrd.settle_dict as settleDict, prrd.payment_condition as paymentCondition, prrd.supplier_remark as supplierRemark, prrd.purchase_remark as purchaseRemark, prrd.currency, prrd.create_time as createTime, prrd.delivery_id as deliveryId, prrd.delivery_detail_id as deliveryDetailId, prrd.delivery_code as deliveryCode, prrd.discount_rate as discountRate, prrd.prepay_amount as prepayAmount, prrd.discount_tax_amount as discountTaxAmount, prrd.remark
mapper.select:
WITH reconciled as ( select source_detail_id, sum(qty) as reconciledQty from po_reconciliation_ref_detail where is_deleted = false group by source_detail_id ) select
, po.source_code as poSourceCode, po.source_type as poSourceType, prd.qty as billQty, rd.reconciledQty - prrd.qty as reconciledQty from po_reconciliation_ref_detail prrd left join po_reconciliation_detail prd on prrd.source_detail_id = prd.source_detail_id and prd.is_deleted = false left join reconciled rd on prrd.source_detail_id = rd.source_detail_id left join foreign_purchase_order po on prrd.po_id = po.id and po.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} and prrd.is_deleted = false ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
prrd.id desc
